title: Our Group Presentation
source_body:
Yuna: Tom, our group presentation is next Wednesday.
Tom: I know. Our topic is "Animals in Korea," right?
Yuna: Yes. There are four people in our group, so let's divide the work.
Tom: Okay. I can find pictures on the computer.
Yuna: Great. Jimin is good at drawing, so she can make the poster.
Tom: What about Daniel?
Yuna: He speaks loudly and clearly. He can present in front of the class.
Tom: And what about you?
Yuna: I'll write the script. The presentation must be five minutes long.
Tom: When can we meet?
Yuna: How about Monday after school? Let's meet in the library at three thirty.
Tom: Sounds good. I'll tell Jimin and Daniel.
